results.title: Demon Hunters
results.overview: In the blistering desert stands Dee's Money Pit, a strip club where sinners come to drink—and die. When two bikers cross the wrong dancers, their slaughter sparks a collision between a ragtag crew of exorcists, a pair of naïve missionaries, and a homeless drifter with secrets of his own.

results.title: Mimosa
results.overview: In a utopian world where happiness is absolute, a suicide crisis threatens the very existence of humanity. As countless lives are lost and the global happiness index continues to decline, the AI Government assigns Mimosa the mission of restoring happiness and bringing population growth back to the world.  By chance, Mimosa encounters Ash, a man laughing at an advertisement featuring her face. Upon discovering that his happiness level is far below that of everyone else, she sets out to cure him. But as she delves deeper into Ash’s condition, Mimosa uncovers a key that could change the fate of their world forever.

results.title: Dumpster
results.overview: City outskirts, late 90s. In a stifling and toxic slum, where there's no space for naivety nor mistakes, Michele (shortened to Mica) takes refuge in a landfill with his "friend" Luca, who's older than Mica. Their morbid and sick relationship deteriorates further when Mica finds something he shouldn't have come into contact with, but it's something that for him becomes a sudden awakening which will lead Mica to face his greatest fears.

results.title: The Milwaukee Cannibal
results.overview: With documentary cartoonist Derf Backderf, a poignant look back at the story of ‘My Friend Dahmer’, an investigative graphic novel exploring existential issues. The author sets out to explore his adolescence, which was overshadowed by Jeffrey Dahmer, a former high school friend who went on to become a serial killer.

results.title: Forge
results.overview: In Miami, siblings Raymond and Coco Zhang’s art forgery ring flourishes when they encounter a disgraced millionaire in need of their expertise. Meanwhile, FBI Art Crimes agent Emily Lee moves to Miami to investigate a series of mysterious paintings.

results.title: Bisikan Desa Gringsing
results.overview: Hesti searches for her missing father whose path leads her to the cursed village of Desa Gringsing, where she becomes enmeshed in the terror of a restless spirit named Fatimah.

results.title: Silence is Loud
results.overview: Henrietta and Ayo navigate stigma, shame, and a world that would rather they stay quiet.

results.title: Hoe Phase
results.overview: A strapped-for-cash pregnant woman tracks down each hookup from the past month to ask a very important question.

results.title: ...And Out Comes the Wolf
results.overview: Set against the East Bay punk music scene in the mid 1990s, a story of grit and dreams in a world of violence and desperation.

results.title: Singularity
results.overview: 15,000 years before our era, during the Pleistocene, just before the great ice age, three saber-toothed tigers are born in a cave. One of them is markedly different from the others.

results.title: BIG MEAT
results.overview: A pair of siblings try to take down a mega-corporation by making an exposé documentary in the middle of the night!

results.title: Dear Father
results.overview: Separated by distance, a father watches helplessly as his son’s aggression tears his family apart, until a brutal assault and a police investigation expose secrets that challenge everything they believed about love, guilt, and protection.

results.title: Microstar
results.overview: A struggling beauty influencer, Gabriel Rose dreams of becoming an actor. But he lacks both the talent and the connections. After yet another failed audition, he meets Stanislas, a privileged young man from the upper class, who offers him the chance to launch a jewelry brand. Gabriel sees this as an opportunity to gain access to Parisian high society, where everything seems easy, at least on the surface… Meanwhile, he becomes involved with Pauline, a young political ecology researcher. Torn between two worlds, Gabriel searches for his place between image and reality, the desire for success, and the need for love.

results.title: Holy Joe
results.overview: When two altar boys stumble across their priest secretive misdeeds, they plot out an intricate plan to save their parish.

results.title: F*ck de Familie
results.overview: When brother Ben suddenly dies, Bo (Yolanthe Cabau) gets with her husband Saïd the care assigned for Ben's teenage daughter Emma. She wants to do this as well as possible, but clashes already quickly with the rest of the family. Everyone - Bo's parents first - thinks to know what is best for Emma. While her demanding job drives her further and further into a corner, Bo's marriage wavers and all good intentions degenerate into a battle full of old pain, new secrets and family dramas that no therapy helps against.

results.title: Hidden Enemy
results.overview: The happy marriage of Gadis and Andhika unravels when an intrusive friend named Suzi enters their lives and systematically destroys their domestic harmony.

results.title: Love You to Pieces
results.original_title: 너의 살점: 너를 사랑하는 세 가지 방법
results.overview: In a world overrun by zombies, Ah-young, a promising figure skater, is trapped in an ice rink by her mother's obsession. Yoon-il cuts off his own ear and offers it as a way to preserve love forever. Joy searches for a vaccine to save her younger sibling, who has turned into a zombie. In a world where nothing can be trusted, three grotesque stories of love begin.
